title: A telescoping real series whose remainders tend to zero has sum zero
statement: Let a, k : ℕ → ℝ and s ∈ ℝ. Suppose that the real series Σ_j a_j has sum s (HasSum a s, i.e. unconditional summation in ℝ), that a_0 = −k_0 and a_{j+1} = k_j − k_{j+1} for every j ∈ ℕ, and that k_j → 0 as j → ∞. Then s = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (a k : ℕ → ℝ) (s : ℝ), HasSum a s → a 0 = -k 0 → (∀ j, a (j + 1) = k j - k (j + 1)) → Tendsto k atTop (𝓝 0) → s = 0
